# Program (b): read n, read n integers, bubble sort ascending, print.
# Registers: 0=n, 1..5=elements (max 5 elements), 9=temp
# This code is generated by gen_sort.py -- see that file / README.md
# for why an unrolled, guarded comparison network is used instead of
# a normal indexed loop (this ISA has no array/indirect addressing).

read
istore 0
# read element 0 only if i < n
ldc 0
iload 0
isub
iflt DO_READ_0
ldc 0
ifeq SKIP_READ_1
DO_READ_0:
read
istore 1
SKIP_READ_1:
# read element 1 only if i < n
ldc 1
iload 0
isub
iflt DO_READ_1
ldc 0
ifeq SKIP_READ_2

iload 0

iflt DO_READ_4
ldc 0
ifeq SKIP_READ_5

read
istore 5
SKIP_READ_5:

# ---- pass 0 ----
# compare/swap regs 1,2 only if 1 < n
ldc 1
iload 0
isub
iflt CMP_0_0
ldc 0
ifeq SKIP_CMP_6
CMP_0_0:
iload 1
iload 2
isub

ldc 0

iload 9
istore 2

ldc 2
iload 0
isub

ldc 0
ifeq SKIP_CMP_8

ifeq SKIP_CMP_8
